thread:
Ellie Ramos: quick shoutout — enormous thanks to Raj, Maria, and infra for the 2pm save. The fallback stack kicked in and the demo stayed smooth. Seriously, y'all saved our skin :sparkles: :tada:

Raj Patel: glad it held together! I rolled the emergency fallback policy and nuked a stale kv cache. weird edge case but fixed. :wrench:

Maria Chen: also huge props to @ops-bot for the on-call alert that actually pointed to the right pod. and Sam for staying to reproduce with me. :coffee: 10/10 teamwork.

Sam Ortiz: my evening plan of Netflix + sadness got upgraded to Netflix + pride. If anyone needs the repro steps, paste below — small script that triggers the bad sequence:

Sam Ortiz: ```bash
# repro: forces old kv cache + large prefix
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2b","prompt":"<long_prefix>","max_tokens":512}'
# then run:
ssh infra@runner-23 'tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/engine.log'
```

Ellie Ramos: filing a tiny follow-up ticket for a better cache-invalidation watch, but wanted to call out the heroics now. Also — free sushi in the kitchen (Lena volunteered) for anyone who helped/demo'd. :sushi:

Lena Park: true — putting out a small celebratory sushi box and some tea at 4pm in the kitchen. if you grabbed one, leave a sticky note with your name so we don't accidentally double-claim. :memo:

ops-bot: incident #2026: fallback_policy_triggered acknowledged by Raj Patel. Latency anomaly mitigated. :white_check_mark:

Raj Patel: tiny follow-up: pushed a canary that tightens the prefix cache TTL. monitoring for 2 hours. thanks again everyone. :raised_hands:

Maria Chen: shoutout thread: "micro-heroes" wins the week. also anyone who wants to pair on the watch script ping me — should be a 15m job. :coffee:

Sam Ortiz: i'll take the pairing slot. and i call dibs on the last spicy tuna roll. :handshake:
